Vampiric Bloodline.theme: Strefan turns life loss into Blood and attacking Vampires.
Vampiric Bloodline.plan: Develop Blood and mana, then send Strefan into combat to deploy larger Vampires.
Vampiric Bloodline.mulligan: Keep three lands, an early Vampire, and a way to make or use Blood.
Vampiric Bloodline.tip: Strefan counts players who lost life, including you, once per end step.

Spirit Squadron.theme: Millicent discounts herself for your Spirits and replaces departing nontoken Spirits.
Spirit Squadron.plan: Build an evasive Spirit army, protect it, and keep attacking for more tokens.
Spirit Squadron.mulligan: Keep two or three lands, inexpensive Spirits, and draw or interaction.
Spirit Squadron.tip: Tokens help pay for Millicent but only nontoken Spirits produce her combat and death triggers.

Buckle Up.theme: Kotori gives your Vehicles crew 2 and helps an artifact creature race with lifelink.
Buckle Up.plan: Play Vehicles and cheap crew, then use Kotori to turn parked artifacts into attackers.
Buckle Up.mulligan: Keep three lands, an affordable Vehicle, and enough creatures to crew it.
Buckle Up.tip: A newly created Pilot can crew immediately; summoning sickness still matters for the Vehicle attacking.

Upgrades Unleashed.theme: Chishiro makes Spirits for Auras and Equipment and grows your modified creatures.
Upgrades Unleashed.plan: Develop creatures, add modifications, and spread counters with Chishiro at each end step.
Upgrades Unleashed.mulligan: Keep three lands, a creature, and a cheap Aura or Equipment.
Upgrades Unleashed.tip: The original list includes two Mossfire Valley cards; both are preserved. Counters, Equipment, and Auras you control modify a creature.

Heads I Win, Tails You Lose.theme: Zndrsplt draws from won flips while Okaun doubles his power and toughness.
Heads I Win, Tails You Lose.plan: Build mana, deploy both partners, and turn successful flips into cards and one huge attack.
Heads I Win, Tails You Lose.mulligan: Keep three lands, a mana rock, and a repeatable coin-flip card.
Heads I Win, Tails You Lose.tip: Krark’s Thumb flips extra coins but ignored results do not trigger either partner.

Riveteers Rampage.theme: Henzie gives large creature spells blitz and discounts blitz for your command-zone casts.
Riveteers Rampage.plan: Ramp into hasty blitz creatures, collect death value, and reuse them from the graveyard.
Riveteers Rampage.mulligan: Keep three lands, early ramp, and a creature with useful entry or death abilities.
Riveteers Rampage.tip: Blitz provides haste and a death draw; the same permanent is sacrificed at the next end step.

Obscura Operation.theme: Kamiz makes an attacker unblockable, lets it connive, and gives a smaller attacker double strike.
Obscura Operation.plan: Build two or more attackers, filter your hand with connive, and connect with damage payoffs.
Obscura Operation.mulligan: Keep three lands, cheap evasive creatures, and interaction.
Obscura Operation.tip: Connive resolves before Kamiz compares powers for the second attacker.

Bedecked Brokers.theme: Perrie rewards the number of different counter kinds across your permanents.
Bedecked Brokers.plan: Spread different counters, protect your threats with shields, and attack with Perrie’s trample bonus.
Bedecked Brokers.mulligan: Keep three lands, ramp, and a permanent that starts a useful counter kind.
Bedecked Brokers.tip: One shield and three +1/+1 counters represent two counter kinds for Perrie.

Maestros Massacre.theme: Anhelo grants casualty 2 to your first instant or sorcery each turn.
Maestros Massacre.plan: Develop expendable creatures, then sacrifice them to copy powerful spells and protect your engines.
Maestros Massacre.mulligan: Keep three lands, cheap card selection, and a creature with at least two power.
Maestros Massacre.tip: Anhelo counts the first instant or sorcery even if you cast it before he entered.

Cabaretti Cacophony.theme: Kitt Kanto taps your creatures to strengthen and goad an active player’s creature.
Cabaretti Cacophony.plan: Build a wide board, redirect opposing attacks, and finish with token combat payoffs.
Cabaretti Cacophony.mulligan: Keep three lands, a token maker, and an early mana play.
Cabaretti Cacophony.tip: Kitt Kanto can use creatures with summoning sickness to pay her optional two-creature tap.
